[javadoc] Correct CharUtils default-value conversion descriptions (#1816)
* [javadoc] Correct CharUtils default-value conversion descriptions

The toIntValue overloads accepting a default return that value for non-ASCII-numeric characters. Describe the fallback instead of incorrectly promising an exception.

Co-authored-by: OpenAI Codex <codex@openai.com>

* [javadoc] Specify the ASCII digit range for default conversions

Clarify both default-value toIntValue overloads accept digits '0' to '9', addressing the review's wording ambiguity.

Co-authored-by: OpenAI Codex <codex@openai.com>

* [javadoc] Use the primitive return type in conversion descriptions

Describe the default-value overloads as returning int rather than Integer, matching their signatures and addressing review feedback.

Co-authored-by: OpenAI Codex <codex@openai.com>

chore: replace Anakia printable docs with CSS @media print
The printable documentation was generated by a separate Anakia/Velocity
pipeline, but its only differences from the regular site (no sidebar,
no social widgets, no ¶ anchors, full-width content) are trivially
achieved with @media print CSS rules that already existed in
new-style.css. Remove the Anakia infrastructure and its dependencies
so the project has a single XSLT-based doc pipeline instead of two.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

Core: Include row lineage and key-id in snapshot value methods (#17015)
Include snapshot row-lineage fields and manifest list key IDs in BaseSnapshot equals/hashCode and toString. This keeps comparisons and hashes aligned with metadata that changes row ID assignment or manifest-list encryption key selection, and makes those values visible in debug output.

Co-authored-by: Codex <codex@openai.com>

CI: Check ASF action allowlist on every PR (#16926)
Remove path filters from the ASF allowlist workflow so it runs for all pull requests and pushes to main.

This surfaces upstream approved-pattern drift as a visible check failure even when a pull request does not edit workflow files.

Fixes #16914

KAFKA-21003 Verify replica assignments in CreateTopicsRequestTest (#23326)
`testValidCreateTopicsRequests` creates topics with manual replica
assignments, but the existing metadata verification only checks the
replica count of the first partition.

This change verifies that every manually assigned partition exists and
that its replica IDs and ordering match the requested assignment.
Generated and default replica assignments continue to use the existing
replication-factor checks.
